submission.title: Assignment locality for Boolean evaluation of arbitrary CNFs
submission.claim: For the submitted explicit CNF and Boolean evaluation definitions, any two assignments agreeing on every variable occurring in a CNF produce equal Boolean evaluations of that CNF. This isolates a reusable locality lemma for later SAT certificate and finite-support constructions.
submission.novelty: A constructive formalization integrating the familiar locality principle with list-based CNF evaluation. It is useful as an accepted reusable research artifact; no new complexity-theoretic result is claimed. This proof was written by the project during development and is also disclosed in the reviewed protocol test fixtures before this PR, not an independent outside contribution or previously rewarded result.

evidence.reproduce: Use the trusted open-agent check research/submissions/assignment-locality.json --lean with the reviewed pinned Docker image.

attribution.contributions: The project's mathematics subagent wrote and checked this proof; the integrating project agent prepared this submission. Both dedicated pilot identities are operated by the same project and GitHub account; no independent-controller claim.

submission.limitations: Known SAT infrastructure only. The statement concerns exact submitted Boolean-list definitions, not runtime complexity, all encodings of SAT, or P versus NP. Prior variable-renaming and namespace rewards are not requested again. No dependency or impact award is claimed for this first result.
